name: Zach Witkoff
current_role: Co-founder and chief executive of World Liberty Financial; chairman of ALT5 Sigma
summary: Zach Witkoff, a son of special envoy Steve Witkoff, co-founded the Trump family’s crypto company World Liberty Financial in 2024 and runs it as chief executive. He announced the use of its USD1 stablecoin for Abu Dhabi fund MGX’s $2 billion Binance investment, signed its agreements with Pakistan, chairs the WLFI treasury company ALT5 Sigma, and has called Justin Sun’s lawsuit against the company meritless.
